candidats.titre: File:'Haunted window' of The Black Horse Inn, Nuthurst, West Sussex 2.jpg
candidats.description: Upstairs window of the Black Horse Inn public house , one of Sussex's most haunted pubs, on Nuthurst Street in Nuthurst , West Sussex , England. In this window at the front of the building is often seen the ghostly face of a young woman who is believed met an untimely death, local knowledge stating she was one of the pub's serving maids or female occupants of the cottages before they were converted as part of today's inn. The Black Horse is also haunted by a local murderer who drank here and moves items across a table (see 'Haunted table' of The Black Horse Inn ); by the ghost of 'Nuthurst Ned

candidats.titre: File:Bar window of Black Horse Inn, Nuthurst, West Sussex.jpg
candidats.description: Looking through the bar window of The Black Horse Inn public house , one of Sussex's most haunted pubs, on Nuthurst Street in Nuthurst , West Sussex , England, part of the 17th-century Black Horse Cottages Grade II listed buildings . The Black Horse Inn is reputedly haunted by a local murderer who drank here (see 'Haunted table' of The Black Horse Inn ). Over the years, local people have observed pints of beer and other objects sliding without human agency across the table seen just inside the window at the left. Regulars have it that this was the table at which, many years ago, regularly sat
